title: A longitudinal open cohort study on the prevention and reduction of burnout symptoms among healthcare professionals using the LAGOM program
summary: LAGOM is a burnout prevention program aimed at healthcare professionals. Working closely with Charité employees, we, an interdisciplinary scientific team, have developed a target group-specific concept for everyday working life, both at the behavioral and relational levels. The feasibility and effectiveness of LAGOM have already been investigated. Now, the progression of burnout symptoms and relevant health economic parameters over time will be recorded and analyzed as part of a cohort study. The aim is to investigate the extent to which LAGOM contributes to reducing stress and improving economic efficiency.

interventions.name: The LAGOM program runs for 9 weeks and consists of three-hour sessions at the beginning and end of the program, as well as 7 x 90-minute sessions (one session per week).
